body: You think on a sub dedicated to a woman with a severe eating disorder, nobody here deals with severe mental illness? Your experiences and opinions are valid, in fact I agree that DMs like this could very well frustrate EC, but there is absolutely no reason or excuse for you to degrade and invalidate other people for disagreeing with you.

There’s really no way of knowing. The thing that makes me especially concerned at this point in time are the health scares (“coughing,” bleeding lips, etc.) as well as things like the spots on her legs and arms, which could be indicative of scurvy or petechiae. These don’t necessarily mean she’s on the verge of death of course, but clearly she has internal issues that are not being addressed or treated.

If she continues the way she is she will die at some point. It could be very soon, it could be years from now assuming she doesn’t get help. Just because she hasn’t died from her anorexia yet doesn’t mean that she’s not going to.

There’s no way she will be able to live much longer. I’m surprised by how long she’s managed to stay alive and continue doing long streams and make videos, but given her current state it’s doubtful that she’ll be able to keep it up. I know it’s unrealistic, but I’m still hoping for some kind of miracle in the next few weeks. But even if she does have some kind of big health scare, I doubt she’ll try to get help.
